name: perfloop
description: Perfloop finds performance problems, bugs and security flaws in your code. Each change comes with proof: a measurement or a tested assertion. Your coding agent can steer it.

interface.longDescription:
Perfloop finds performance problems, bugs and security flaws in your code. Perfloop measures each performance change it proposes against the original code. Your team chooses the repos and goals Perfloop works on.

Each correctness claim proves one stated assertion about the code with the change. A bug fix or security repair must fail its test on the original code and pass after the change. Your plan and each repo's settings in Setup decide which kinds of work Perfloop does. Security work is defensive: Perfloop finds security flaws in the repos you connect and proves fixes for them. It is available on Pro and Enterprise, once the Perfloop team turns it on for your workspace. Only members of your workspace can see a security Case, even for a public repo. When Perfloop reviews a pull request on a public repo, the review leaves out security findings. Perfloop does not open a pull request or issue for a security fix on a public repo. Download the fix from the Case; if someone else maintains the repo, send it to them privately. Read https://perfloop.ai/docs/work/security before sharing a finding.

With Perfloop connected, your agent can submit a branch or a pull request, and Perfloop lists ranked hypotheses on the changed code, each with a size estimate. Read a Case's evidence and measurements. Start or stop work on it, and steer it with feedback. Decide what waits in the Inbox, such as a pull request that is ready to open.

Perfloop opens pull requests. It cannot approve or merge one, and it cannot deploy. Every write is recorded under your account.

You need a Perfloop account with a connected GitHub repo. You sign in with that account, and your role in the workspace decides what the agent can read or change. Tools that start work say so, because that work is paid from the workspace's Usage balance.
capabilities: List Cases and read the evidence and code behind each one
Start or stop work on a Case
File feedback that steers the work
Read the model Perfloop keeps of your system
Create an Initiative and steer its research
Submit a branch or pull request and read ranked hypotheses about performance, bugs and security
Decide what waits in the Inbox
defaultPrompt: Which Perfloop Cases on my repo are verified, and what did each one measure?
What performance problems, bugs and security flaws did Perfloop find on my open pull request?
What is waiting for my decision in the Perfloop Inbox?

publication.release_notes: Adds the Perfloop agent skill and describes performance, bug and security work, each with proof.
